seo.title: Bhutaneses Culture - Lotus Peak
seo.description: Bhutan, often called the Last Himalayan Kingdom, is a land of stunning landscapes, spiritual depth, and a rich cultural tapestry that has been preserved for centuries. Nestled between India and China, this small Himalayan nation has managed to retain its traditions, making it a living museum of heritage and spiritual practices. From colorful festivals to unique customs, Bhutanese culture is vibrant, deeply spiritual, and closely intertwined with daily life.
